description.zh: 所有與會小馬迷的歡樂合影！
description.en: A joyful group photo of all attending pony fans!

description.en: The energetic crowd cheering during the live stage performances.

description.zh: 同好們在創作者攤位前熱烈交流與選購精美周邊。
description.en: Attendees browsing and chatting with local brony creators at their booths.

title.zh: 大會紀念周邊與識別證

description.en: A close-up of the beautifully designed TWBC badges and official souvenirs.
